name: Tungsten Parts Wyoming
old_description: U.S.-owned manufacturer of high-density tungsten components - produced powder-to-finish in Laramie, Wyoming, under AS9100D and ISO 9001, with an annual production capacity of 1.6 million kilograms.
about:
Tungsten Parts Wyoming (TPW) is a U.S.-owned tungsten manufacturer based in Laramie, Wyoming, led by CEO Mark Holden. The company operates two production facilities in Laramie, producing high-density tungsten components from powder to finish.

TPW produces tungsten products and custom tungsten components using powder-to-finish processes that include precision finishing, production execution, and first-article inspection. The facilities span 50,000 square feet with 24/7 production capability and an annual capacity of 1.6 million kilograms.

The company serves defense, aerospace, and industrial customers who require dependable supply, repeatable manufacturing outcomes, and parts that meet exact specifications. Engineers and procurement teams rely on TPW for consistent density, predictable delivery, and documentation that withstands program review.

TPW differentiates itself by controlling the full process from powder to finished part, offering cobalt-free chemistry when required, and maintaining compliance with ISO 9001, AS9100D, ITAR, DFARS, and CAGE 842W5. Domestic powder-to-finish production reduces supply-chain risk and provides direct accountability.
